messages:
alex: Hey team — I'm putting together a compact guide for where to find our latency signals (p50/p95/p99, TTFT, tokens/sec) for folks doing RCA and onboarding. Need: canonical dashboards, a trace sample link, a raw tokens/sec query, and a recommended alert rule that avoids firing on autoscale blips. Drop links/snippets I can copy.
maria: Start with the Grafana collection: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/ops/latency-signals. Look for panels: "TTFT by model (p95/p99)" and "Ingress tokens/sec". Add the folder to your bookmarks.
sanjay: Traces: use Jaeger service filter service=runtime and operation=emitTokens. Example trace search URL (swap timeframe/traceID): https://jaeger.redwood.internal/trace?service=runtime&operation=emitTokens&traceID=<trace_id>
jess: Logs/samples in Kibana under index redwood-requests-*. Recommended Discover columns: @timestamp, request_id, model, tokens_emitted, ttft_ms, cache_hit. Save as "latency-samples" saved search.
obs-bot: Quick links for the doc:
- Grafana latency folder: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/ops/latency-signals
- TTFT panel direct: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/panels/ttft-pXX
- Tokens/sec panel: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/panels/tokens-per-sec
- Jaeger: https://jaeger.redwood.internal/
- Kibana saved searches: https://kibana.redwood.internal/app/discover#saved/latency-samples
maria: PromQL snippets you can paste (slightly different phrasing than our long docs):
```promql
# p95 TTFT (seconds) per model over 5m windows
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(runtime_ttft_bucket[5m])) by (le, model))

# global tokens/sec (1m)
sum(rate(tokens_emitted_total[1m]))
```
Multiply TTFT by 1000 if you want ms in the panel.
sanjay: For alert tuning: aim to detect sustained tail regressions. Example alert (mute short spikes + avoid autoscale windows):
```yaml
alert: TTFT_P99_SustainedHigh
expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(runtime_ttft_bucket[5m])) by (le, model)) > 1.0
for: 10m
labels:
  severity: page
annotations:
  summary: "TTFT p99 > 1s for >10m for {{ $labels.model }}"
```
Then add recording rule or silence when cluster_autoscaling_active == 1 (we emit cluster_autoscaling_active gauge during scale ops).
jess: Practical tip: when you find a long tail trace in Jaeger, click "View log link" to jump to the Kibana line for the same request_id. That gives tokens_emitted and any cache tags; helps correlate tokens/sec drops to p99 spikes.
alex: Nice. Can we also include a short Grafana panel description I can paste? One-liners for p95 vs p99 and tokens/sec.
maria: Sure: "p95: typical user latency; p99: tail latency that captures UX-impacting slow requests. TTFT is measured from request start to first token emitted. Tokens/sec is the throughput signal from the ingest side and correlates with backend load and node availability."
sanjay: If you need an incident example: we saw a tokens/sec collapse during a node drain last week — postmortem snippet: https://slack.redwood/internal/archives/C12345/p1620001111 - tokens/sec dropped ~60% and p99 jumped. Add that as a callout.
jess: I'll attach a saved Jaeger example trace ID and the Kibana saved search in the PR later today.
alex: This is perfect. I'll build the short doc + PR and ping for quick review around 16:00 UTC. Thanks! :thumbsup:
